label: def:polygonal-link-type
title: Polygonal links and link types
html:
A polygonal link in a real inner-product space V is a finite family of closed polygons in V whose carriers are simple and pairwise disjoint.

A \Delta-move replaces one edge [a,b] of a component by the two edges [a,c] and [c,b], or performs the inverse replacement, provided the triangle with vertices a, b, c meets the link only in the edge [a,b]. Re-indexing the components and re-indexing the vertices of a component are also \Delta-moves.

Two polygonal links are \Delta-equivalent when a finite sequence of \Delta-moves carries one to the other. The link type of a polygonal link is its \Delta-equivalence class. Throughout this paper, "link type" and "isotopic link" refer to this class. For \dim V = 3 the class coincides with the PL ambient isotopy class (Reidemeister; see Lickorish, Chapter 1).
